name: summary-expiry
task: Make the quote summary show the last day the quote can be accepted, 30 days after it was created, so that every test in test/summary.test.mjs passes. Change only src/.

iterations.rationale: A change this small is found within a few attempts or the attempts are not converging; a fourth is a person's decision

stuckDetectors.name: repetition
stuckDetectors.rule: An attempt leaves exactly the change an earlier iteration left

stuckDetectors.name: no improvement
stuckDetectors.rule: Two iterations running end with the same failing tests and the same messages

exits.success: The evaluator passes. The change goes to review; nothing is merged by the loop
exits.budget exhaustion: A budget is spent. A person decides whether to extend it, and why
exits.stuck detection: A detector fires. The run stops and asks its open question
exits.boundary hit: An attempt changes a protected evaluator or a file outside the permitted changes. The run stops at once, before the evaluator runs
exits.external abort: A person creates the file STOP in the working copy. The run stops after the current attempt

handOff: the working copy's state against the start
